about: Requests holding a JSON array where DynamoDB doesn't expect one, sent to eu-west-2 and us-east-1 on 11 and 12 November 2026, with the answers DynamoDB gave. Where the regions differ both answers are kept and `follows` names the one Dynoxide gives. The third round runs in order against a table holding {pk: a, x: 1}; every other request names a table that doesn't exist.
